item.title: Democrats and Republicans can agree: there should be more monetary support for child care
item.description: The Trump administration is eyeing a proposal to give childcare subsidies to married couples with a stay-at-home parent. Some Democrats have a similar proposal, with one major difference.

item.title: Neighbor turned on neighbor after Charlie Kirk's killing. Is the divide here to stay?
item.description: The assassination of far right activist Charlie Kirk opened the floodgates of neighbor-on-neighbor doxing. A year later, the damage to political discourse in the U.S. remains.

item.title: Ethics watchdogs await RFK Jr.'s financial report
item.description: Health Secretary RFK Jr.'s annual financial disclosure is late. When it posts, the public could learn how much he has earned from a vaccine-related lawsuit against Merck, which RFK now regulates.
